faq.q: Do my AI agents stay active if inter-island internet drops?
faq.a: Yes. Every Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated cloud computer 24/7. Even if your local connection drops or your mobile device is turned off, scheduled tasks, web scraping, and automated scripts keep executing.

faq.q: Can I manage my agents directly via Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with your agents individually on Telegram or add them into group chats where multiple specialist bots collaborate as a coordinated digital operations team.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo bots operate fluently in English, French, Spanish, and dozens of other international languages, allowing you to converse naturally and assist international yachting and tourism clients easily.

faq.q: How do Ceyo integrations connect with my current software?
